svg.title: Top-down cutaway of Vayora's four internal modules. Air enters at the rear and flows to the front through the air purification module (pre-filter, HEPA-type filter, activated carbon filter) and the cooling module (cooling pad fed by a top-fill tank, cooling fan, airflow outlet). The electronics and battery module (sensors and display, rechargeable battery, control board) sits at the front corner. The MosquitoGuard module sits along the side wall, with its own intake, UV-A light, scent lure cartridge, one-way funnel, removable mesh collection chamber and a separate suction fan that exhausts to the side.
